## Purpose and scope
Which behavior, research question or publication issue is addressed? Link to the relevant engineering rules and active source protocol.

## Changed-file impact report
For each added, changed, moved or deleted path, state its purpose, imports/callers affected, tests, and whether any original source/evidence identity changes. Do not perform unrelated refactors or hide parallel implementations.

## Validation
- [ ] Exact Git source revision and targeted test commands recorded
- [ ] Source-only tests pass (or failure and traceback preserved)
- [ ] Compiler source/decision evidence compared with independent oracle where meaningful
- [ ] No claims of native timing, actual physical latency or board performance without qualified evidence
- [ ] No original frozen studies or SHA receipts overwritten
- [ ] No newly introduced GitHub Actions or implicit Vitis/Vivado invocations
- [ ] No credentials, restricted hardware artifacts, personal data or private weights

## Scientific interpretation
Separate observed results, derived estimates, UNKNOWN values, expected controls, and unexecuted plans. Preserve negative baselines and all denominator counts.

## Publication and rights
Source visibility does not grant a license. Confirm maintainers have cleared any institutional/third-party rights before authorizing redistribution. This PR is not a publication authorization.
